_comment: 12 reference monsters establishing the monster schema. loot_table chance is 0..1; currency drops use is_currency+currency_id.

chicken.name: Scrub Fowl
chicken.flavour: Half-wild fowl that survived the ashfall by being too aggressive to catch.

cow.name: Longhorn Steer
cow.flavour: Frontier cattle, patient and enormous. The horns are not decorative.

golbin.name: Cinderkin Raider
golbin.flavour: Ash-touched scavengers. Quick, poorly armoured, and they never raid alone.

zombie_hand.name: Graveclaw
zombie_hand.flavour: A hand that kept working after the rest of it stopped.

skeleton.name: Barrowbones
skeleton.flavour: Cairn debris, walking. The barrows resent being opened.

spider.name: Fen Spinner
spider.flavour: Reed-height and patient. The web is the warning.

bandit.name: Sable Rook
bandit.flavour: Road-thieves in dyed leather. They know the viaduct better than you do.

moss_giant.name: Mossbound Colossus
moss_giant.flavour: Old stone that grew a coat and decided to stand up.

guard.name: Sunderhold Sentry
guard.flavour: Still on duty. The orders are older than the settlement.

rune_knight.name: Glyphbound Knight
rune_knight.flavour: Armour written over with binding script. The script is winning.

green_dragon.name: Verdant Wyrm
green_dragon.flavour: Slept through the ashfall under the moss. Waking up irritable.

golbin_chief.name: Cinderkin Warchief
golbin_chief.flavour: Leads the Warrens. Wears the settlement's missing anvil as a shield.

air_god.name: Warden of Gales, Sylphine
air_god.flavour: Keeper of the summit instruments. She has been waiting for a student, not a challenger.

water_elemental.name: Tide Wisp
water_elemental.flavour: Water that has been told what to do.

water_god.name: Warden of Tides, Marrowen
water_god.flavour: Keeps the reliquary's ledger. Everyone's name is in it.

earth_god.name: Warden of Stone, Delvhar
earth_god.flavour: He cut the mine that broke the ridge, and he will not explain why.

fire_elemental.name: Ember Wisp
fire_elemental.flavour: A coal that learned to move.

fire_god.name: Warden of Embers, Pyrra
fire_god.flavour: Tends the kiln. Believes the ashfall was the correct price.

mist_wraith.name: Murk Wraith
mist_wraith.flavour: Ash and drowned breath, holding a shape out of habit.

the_mist.name: The Murk Incarnate
the_mist.flavour: The ashfall given a voice. It repeats what you said, later.

dark_herald.name: Herald of the Long Dusk
dark_herald.flavour: Announces the dark the way weather announces rain.

drowned_sailor.name: Barnacled Deckhand
drowned_sailor.flavour: Kept working the drowned road. Still on shift.

underwater_king.name: Tidewrack King
underwater_king.flavour: Rules Nhalassar's upper terraces and resents the surface.

abyssal_imp.name: Umbral Imp
abyssal_imp.flavour: Small, fast, and delighted to be here.

abyssal_fiend.name: Umbral Fiend
abyssal_fiend.flavour: The Deep's outrider. Built out of what it has eaten.

umbral_stalker.name: Umbral Stalker
umbral_stalker.flavour: It hunts by the sound of your footsteps, and the Deep carries every one.

bastion_sentinel.name: Bastion Sentinel
bastion_sentinel.flavour: A garrison that kept its post after there was nothing left to guard.

cinder_archer.name: Cinder Archer
cinder_archer.flavour: It fires embers it has been carrying since the siege.

bastion_warden.name: Bastion Warden
bastion_warden.flavour: Keeper of the Keep's last door. It has not been relieved.

marsh_hulk.name: Marsh Hulk
marsh_hulk.flavour: Peat, bone and a patience older than the road.

gloam_witch.name: Gloam Witch
gloam_witch.flavour: She sells fog by the lungful and takes payment later.

gloam_matron.name: Gloam Matron
gloam_matron.flavour: The marsh's oldest tenant. It does not leave; the road came to it.

abyssal_lord.name: Umbral Lord
abyssal_lord.flavour: Commands the Deep's attention, which is a job nobody wants.

silent_pilgrim.name: Silent Pilgrim
silent_pilgrim.flavour: It walks toward the Herald's seat and has never once looked back.

hush_stalker.name: Hush Stalker
hush_stalker.flavour: You hear nothing, and then you are already hit.

echoless_cantor.name: Echoless Cantor
echoless_cantor.flavour: It sings, and the song takes the sound out of everything near it.

warden_of_the_hush.name: Warden of the Hush
warden_of_the_hush.flavour: Keeper of the Silent Gate. Nothing it has struck has made a sound.

hollow_brute.name: Hollow Brute
hollow_brute.flavour: A suit of something with nothing in it, and it still hits like a wall.

static_seer.name: Static Seer
static_seer.flavour: It reads the air between words, and finds yours already written.

the_silence.name: The Silence
the_silence.flavour: What the Herald was a herald of. It has been here all along, waiting to be noticed.

ascendant_dark_herald.name: Ascendant Herald of the Long Dusk
ascendant_dark_herald.flavour: The Dusk, made to answer for itself.

ascendant_tidewrack_king.name: Ascendant Tidewrack King
ascendant_tidewrack_king.flavour: The tide does not recede. It has been promoted.

ascendant_the_herald.name: Ascendant Herald
ascendant_the_herald.flavour: The Herald's crown, worn by someone who finished the job.

the_herald.name: The Herald Ascendant
the_herald.flavour: The ashfall wearing a crown. It has been waiting at the Seat for you.

cinderkin_scout.name: Cinderkin Scout
cinderkin_scout.flavour: Ash tunnel scouts mark trespassers for the raiders behind them.

barrow_wraith.name: Barrow Wraith
barrow_wraith.flavour: A forgotten name wrapped in burial cloth and cold blue fire.

drowned_wayfarer.name: Drowned Wayfarer
drowned_wayfarer.flavour: The old coastal road still leads its travelers out of the surf.

rook_marksman.name: Rook Marksman
rook_marksman.flavour: Rook archers watch the viaduct from the ruins above.

frostfang_wolf.name: Frostfang Wolf
frostfang_wolf.flavour: Ice gathers on its fangs before the pack even comes into view.

ash_drake.name: Ash Drake
ash_drake.flavour: Young ashwyrms stalk the lava vents below the greater wyrm.

broodweb_hunter.name: Broodweb Hunter
broodweb_hunter.flavour: A long-legged ambusher that waits where the web meets the reeds.

rift_weaver.name: Rift Weaver
rift_weaver.flavour: It knots broken space into snares around Riftmouth.

greyharrow_husk.name: Greyharrow Husk
greyharrow_husk.flavour: A man-shaped absence in the dust. It stands where the cut was deepest.

shale_stalker.name: Shale Stalker
shale_stalker.flavour: Flat as a fallen slab until it isn't. The shard-spray comes first, the bite after.

quarry_echo.name: Quarry Echo
quarry_echo.flavour: Whatever was shouted here last still hasn't finished. It always finds you.

slag_golem.name: Slag Golem
slag_golem.flavour: Kiln-waste and old mortar, knitted into something with a temper.

brine_troll.name: Brine Troll
brine_troll.flavour: It has been sitting in the same pool so long the salt grew over its back.

tidewrack_hag.name: Tidewrack Hag
tidewrack_hag.flavour: She sings the tide back in. The tide has not come back. She keeps singing.

sunderhold_centurion.name: Sunderhold Centurion
sunderhold_centurion.flavour: Outranks the sentries still standing their posts. Has not noticed they are dead.

ashwyrm_seer.name: Ashwyrm Seer
ashwyrm_seer.flavour: Reads the caldera the way a sailor reads weather, and has never once been wrong.

sunderhold_ballistarius.name: Sunderhold Ballistarius
sunderhold_ballistarius.flavour: Sights the breach from the wall and never wastes a bolt on anything closer.

tidebound_revenant.name: Tidebound Revenant
tidebound_revenant.flavour: A drowned harpooner who never let go of the line. It still throws.

stormglass_warden.name: Stormglass Warden
stormglass_warden.flavour: Lightning that struck the same sand twice and cooled into a sentry.

cinder_colossus.name: Cinder Colossus
cinder_colossus.flavour: A forge-heap the Herald taught to walk. Each step leaves a glowing print.

herald_zealot.name: Herald's Zealot
herald_zealot.flavour: Sworn to the throne beyond the march, and patient with a crossbow.

umbral_harbinger.name: Umbral Harbinger
umbral_harbinger.flavour: The first shadow the Deep sends up. Where it stands, the light thins.

astral_sanctum_guardian_melee.name: Astral Sanctum Melee Sentinel
astral_sanctum_guardian_melee.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

astral_sanctum_guardian_ranged.name: Astral Sanctum Ranged Sentinel
astral_sanctum_guardian_ranged.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

astral_sanctum_boss.name: Celestial Tidekeeper
astral_sanctum_boss.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

storm_citadel_guardian_melee.name: Storm Citadel Melee Sentinel
storm_citadel_guardian_melee.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

storm_citadel_guardian_ranged.name: Storm Citadel Ranged Sentinel
storm_citadel_guardian_ranged.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

storm_citadel_boss.name: Tempest Marshal
storm_citadel_boss.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

crown_of_embers_guardian_melee.name: Crown of Embers Melee Sentinel
crown_of_embers_guardian_melee.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

crown_of_embers_guardian_ranged.name: Crown of Embers Ranged Sentinel
crown_of_embers_guardian_ranged.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

crown_of_embers_boss.name: The Last Forgemaster
crown_of_embers_boss.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

sundered_tyrant.name: The Sundered Tyrant
sundered_tyrant.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

drowned_leviathan.name: Drowned Leviathan
drowned_leviathan.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

march_warlord.name: Warlord of the March
march_warlord.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

dream_choir.name: The Sunken Choir
dream_choir.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

dream_tide.name: The Astral Devourer
dream_tide.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

dream_sovereign.name: The Sleeping Sovereign
dream_sovereign.flavour: A guardian awakened beyond the old frontier.

archive_guardian_melee.name: Archive Bladekeeper
archive_guardian_melee.flavour: A keeper of pages that were never written.

archive_guardian_ranged.name: Archive Quillshot
archive_guardian_ranged.flavour: A keeper of pages that were never written.

archive_guardian_magic.name: Archive Glyphweaver
archive_guardian_magic.flavour: A keeper of pages that were never written.

archive_boss.name: The Last Librarian
archive_boss.flavour: A keeper of pages that were never written.

ironveil_bulwark.name: Ironveil Bulwark
ironveil_bulwark.flavour: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies burn. Armour absorbs part of every hit. At 50% HP: Furnace ignition; at 20% HP: Ironveil last stand.

cinder_artillerist.name: Cinder Artillerist
cinder_artillerist.flavour: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies burn. At 50% HP: Furnace ignition; at 20% HP: Overheated volley.

king_of_the_furnace.name: King of the Furnace
king_of_the_furnace.flavour: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies burn. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 60% HP: Furnace ignition. At 25%: Molten coronation.

shardfang.name: Shardfang
shardfang.flavour: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Whiteout; at 20% HP: Predator's frenzy.

whiteout_oracle.name: Whiteout Oracle
whiteout_oracle.flavour: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies stun. Shrouded evasion. At 50% HP: Whiteout; at 20% HP: Whiteout's edge.

the_glacial_regent.name: The Glacial Regent
the_glacial_regent.flavour: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies stun. At 60% HP: Whiteout. At 25%: Absolute winter.

venomroot_behemoth.name: Venomroot Behemoth
venomroot_behemoth.flavour: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies poison. Venom adds poison pressure. At 50% HP: Blighted bloom; at 20% HP: Venomous collapse.

rotveil_matriarch.name: Rotveil Matriarch
rotveil_matriarch.flavour: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies poison. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 50% HP: Blighted bloom; at 20% HP: Plague crescendo.

the_heart_of_rot.name: The Heart of Rot
the_heart_of_rot.flavour: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies poison. At 60% HP: Blighted bloom. At 25%: Roots drink deep.

drowned_spearmarshal.name: Drowned Spearmarshal
drowned_spearmarshal.flavour: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies bleed. At 50% HP: Crushing depths; at 20% HP: Undertow advance.

tideglass_harrier.name: Tideglass Harrier
tideglass_harrier.flavour: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Crushing depths; at 20% HP: Final surge.

queen_of_the_abyss.name: Queen of the Abyss
queen_of_the_abyss.flavour: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies silence. Shrouded evasion. At 60% HP: Crushing depths. At 25%: Rising undertow.

voidglass_duelist.name: Voidglass Duelist
voidglass_duelist.flavour: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. Shrouded evasion. At 50% HP: Shattered horizon; at 20% HP: Voidglass convergence.

sunless_hierophant.name: Sunless Hierophant
sunless_hierophant.flavour: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies silence. At 50% HP: Shattered horizon; at 20% HP: Last eclipse.

the_eclipse_sovereign.name: The Eclipse Sovereign
the_eclipse_sovereign.flavour: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies stun. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 60% HP: Shattered horizon. At 25%: Total eclipse.

reedbank_field_rat.name: Reedbank Field Rat
reedbank_field_rat.flavour: Plump brown field rat with straw in its fur, sharp ivory teeth, curled tail and tiny ears.

reedbank_slinger.name: Reedbank Slinger
reedbank_slinger.flavour: Small green goblin in a reed hat and patched tan tunic, holding a sling and a pouch of smooth river stones.

lantern_moth.name: Lantern Moth
lantern_moth.flavour: Small golden moth with broad cream wings, glowing amber abdomen, leaf-like antennae and a friendly but menacing magical glow.

strawbound_warden.name: Strawbound Warden
strawbound_warden.flavour: Animated squat scarecrow wearing a burlap hood, glowing amber eyes, straw-stuffed limbs, rusted pitchfork and patched farmer coat.

sootfang_fox.name: Sootfang Fox
sootfang_fox.flavour: Crouching charcoal-red fox with bright amber eyes, sooty fur and ember-orange tail tip.

ashwood_spitter.name: Ashwood Spitter
ashwood_spitter.flavour: Chunky dark woodland beetle with orange cracked shell and a small glowing acid sac beneath its mandibles.

embercap_shaman.name: Embercap Shaman
embercap_shaman.flavour: Small mushroom goblin shaman with glowing orange mushroom cap, grey-green skin, twisted branch staff and ember-spotted robe.

cinderweb_broodmother.name: Cinderweb Broodmother
cinderweb_broodmother.flavour: Large crouched charcoal spider queen with ember-red carapace, ivory fangs, glowing orange eyes and a bright silk spinneret.

grave_sentinel.name: Grave Sentinel
grave_sentinel.flavour: Short skeletal grave guardian wearing mossy iron scraps and a broken stone shield, holding a rusty sword.

moor_bonearcher.name: Moor Bonearcher
moor_bonearcher.flavour: Skeletal archer wrapped in faded teal burial cloth, carrying an old yew bow and bone arrows.

mourning_lantern.name: Mourning Lantern
mourning_lantern.flavour: Haunted bronze lantern floating in a compact swirl of pale blue spectral flame, small skull-like face inside the glass.

bellkeeper_wraith.name: Bellkeeper Wraith
bellkeeper_wraith.flavour: Hooded blue spectral chapel keeper with glowing eyes, carrying a cracked bronze funeral bell and a crooked staff.

tollway_cutthroat.name: Tollway Cutthroat
tollway_cutthroat.flavour: Stocky hooded highway robber in dark brown leather with green scarf, short curved dagger and a stolen coin pouch.

rookwood_crossbowman.name: Rookwood Crossbowman
rookwood_crossbowman.flavour: Masked woodland mercenary wearing brown leather and moss-green cape, aiming a compact steel crossbow.

thornhex_trickster.name: Thornhex Trickster
thornhex_trickster.flavour: Small sly violet woodland imp with thorny antlers, leaf cloak and a glowing lime spell between its hands.

rookwatch_captain.name: Rookwatch Captain
rookwatch_captain.flavour: Armoured outlaw captain with dark iron helmet, raven-feather mantle, heavy crossbow and scarlet belt.

rubble_mauler.name: Rubble Mauler
rubble_mauler.flavour: Compact grey stone brute with ochre rubble fists, moss patches and amber eyes in a heavy craggy face.

flintback_skitterer.name: Flintback Skitterer
flintback_skitterer.flavour: Crab-like quarry creature with a sharp slate shell, flint spikes, stout legs and bright orange eyes.

shale_crystal_wisp.name: Shale Crystal Wisp
shale_crystal_wisp.flavour: Floating cluster of jagged teal crystals surrounding a warm golden magical core, compact mineral spirit with dark stone fragments.

vaultheart_colossus.name: Vaultheart Colossus
vaultheart_colossus.flavour: Massive compact stone guardian with a glowing gold crystal heart, angular slate armour and enormous rock fists.

saltclaw_brute.name: Saltclaw Brute
saltclaw_brute.flavour: Stocky blue-green coastal crab ogre with one huge coral-orange claw, crusted shell armour and glowing yellow eyes.

cliffside_harpooner.name: Cliffside Harpooner
cliffside_harpooner.flavour: Undead coastal harpooner wearing weathered teal seafarer coat, barnacled iron mask, carrying a short harpoon and rope coil.

brineglass_sorcerer.name: Brineglass Sorcerer
brineglass_sorcerer.flavour: Compact sea sorcerer with aqua crystal crown, deep blue robes, coral staff and a swirling green sea spell.

saltglass_oracle.name: Saltglass Oracle
saltglass_oracle.flavour: Regal drowned oracle with luminous aqua eyes, coral crown, dark blue layered robes, curved shell staff and turquoise spectral fins.
